correctness.rationale: Every 14-vertex,21-flag Fano incidence graph automorphism is a GL3(F2) collineation (168) or duality composite (another168). Barycentric subdivision removes edge inversion: fixed geometric points are precisely fixed original vertices and midpoints of setwise H-stabilized flags, with fixed halfedges joining fixed endpoints. Every type-preserving subgroup is found by closure under adjoining collineations; any reversing subgroup is H union Ht for H normalizing and t² in H; the finite generator sweep is exhaustive rather than sampling. Independently built all 336 actions and 413 subgroups (179 type-preserving, 234 reversing), computed each fixed subdivided graph and Euler cycle rank: one wedge of eight circles, 210 contractible, 56 S0, 28 three-point spaces, 118 empty; 28 exceptional groups all reversing polarity order2 with three fixed midpoints. Original verifier and independent second implementation agree. This is exact for Fano only, not arbitrary projective buildings.
